_readme: Zero-shot CLIP prompt sets for the October 2026 pilot. Edit here, not in code. Each cue is scored as P(positive prompt) vs its negative contrast; each typology label is scored against the other labels. Scores are UNCALIBRATED and must be validated against the ~150 hand-labelled images before they are used as measurements. Lighting is deliberately NOT here: CLIP cannot reliably see small objects such as light poles, so streetlight presence/spacing comes from the segmentation/object-detection steps (work plan, steps 3-4).
templates: a photo of {}, taken from the street.

typology._note: Seven CPTED land-use types from the Phase 1 briefing (parks, linear parks/walkways, surface parking, commercial streets, transit nodes, residential, institutional) plus 'road_corridor', added because much of Downtown is traffic-dominated road space that fits none of the seven.
surface_parking: a surface parking lot with parked cars
transit_node: a bus stop or transit terminal
a bus shelter beside a city street
commercial_street: a commercial street with storefronts and shops
a downtown street lined with businesses
riverfront_walkway: a paved walking path beside a river
park_open_space: a park with grass and trees
residential: a residential street with houses or apartment buildings
institutional: a large public building such as a city hall, library or school
road_corridor: a wide road or intersection dominated by traffic
a city road with no shops or pedestrians

positive: graffiti or tagging on a wall
negative: a clean wall with no graffiti

positive: litter and garbage on the ground
negative: a clean sidewalk with no litter

positive: boarded-up or broken windows on a building
an empty vacant lot or an abandoned building
an open storefront with shop windows and signs
negative: a blank wall with no shopfront

positive: a building with many windows facing the street
negative: a building with no windows facing the street
an empty street with no people

positive: a fence, gate or barrier along the edge of the property
